description: MainWearActivity.java is an Android Wearable activity class that manages runtime permissions (BODY_SENSORS, external storage), communicates with a paired phone via GoogleApiClient, handles capability and message events, and updates UI elements accordingly.

classes.name: MainWearActivity
classes.description: An Android Wear activity that manages runtime permissions, communicates with a paired phone, and updates UI based on permission status and capability changes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, GoogleApiClient, and permission states.

methods.name: onClickWearBodySensors
methods.description: Handles click to request or display local sensor info based on permission.

methods.name: onClickPhoneStorage
methods.description: Requests data from the paired phone.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes listeners and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reconnects GoogleApiClient and checks permission status.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents, especially for permission prompts from phone.

methods.name: onEnterAmbient
methods.description: Updates UI for ambient mode.

methods.name: onExitAmbient
methods.description: Restores UI from ambient mode.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Sets up capability and message listeners, and retrieves phone node info.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Logs suspension of GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Logs failure to connect GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Updates phone node info when capability changes.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles result of runtime permission requests.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from the paired phone.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the paired phone node.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from permission prompt activity.

methods.name: pickBestNodeId
methods.description: Selects the best node ID from available nodes.

methods.name: launchPermissionDialogForPhone
methods.description: Requests permission from the phone if not already granted.

methods.name: updatePhoneButtonOnUiThread
methods.description: Updates UI button state based on permission status.

methods.name: logToUi
methods.description: Logs messages to UI and debug log, ensuring main thread execution.
